credits.title: Território em Trânsito
credits.overview: Aracy lives with her grandmother, Dona Iram, in a rural community in the agreste region. She embarks on a journey of enchantment through her own body-territory.

credits.title: The Riverbank
credits.overview: Izaquiel works as a cleaner in Recife, a Brazilian city intertwined with rivers and mangroves. At night, he dangerously ventures out in search of secret encounters in the mangrove forest. His world shifts when he crosses paths with Jeremias, an intriguing and magnetic fisherman.

credits.title: Lamento de Força Travesti
credits.overview: What is your dream? How do you imagine yourself 10 years from now? Being a trans in Brazil is an act of daily resistance, being alive and allowing yourself to dream is necessary.
